title: Marketing analytics — live (rollup-backed)
description: The important live panels only, all reading AggregatingMergeTree rollups maintained by MVs — refresh stays cheap while ingest runs at full speed. Heavy whole-history queries (attribution, cohort) deliberately excluded; they live in the report page.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toDateTime(day) AS t, channel, sumMerge(revenue) AS revenue_usd FROM daily_campaign_rollup WHERE day >= today() - 30 GROUP BY t, channel ORDER BY t

panels.title: Day-90 events (today, climbing live) — Q1 rollup

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(events) AS events_today, uniqMerge(users) AS users_today, sum(purchases) AS purchases_today FROM daily_campaign_rollup WHERE day = today()

SELECT uniqMerge(users) AS visitors, uniqMergeIf(users, event_type = 'lead') AS leads, uniqMergeIf(users, event_type = 'trial_start') AS trials, uniqMergeIf(users, event_type = 'purchase') AS purchasers FROM funnel_rollup WHERE day >= today() - 30

panels.title: Email activity by hour, last 7d — Q7 (partition-pruned raw)

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfHour(event_time) AS t, countIf(event_type = 'email_send') AS sends, countIf(event_type = 'email_open') AS opens, countIf(event_type = 'email_click') AS clicks FROM campaign_events WHERE channel = 'email' AND event_time >= today() - 7 GROUP BY t ORDER BY t

panels.title: List health per campaign — Q8 rollup (3 planted segments must alert)

targets.rawSql: SELECT campaign_id, sumIf(events, event_type = 'email_send') AS sends, round(sumIf(events, event_type = 'unsubscribe') / nullIf(sends, 0) * 100, 2) AS unsub_pct, round(sumIf(events, event_type = 'bounce') / nullIf(sends, 0) * 100, 2) AS bounce_pct FROM email_health_rollup GROUP BY campaign_id HAVING sends > 0 ORDER BY bounce_pct DESC LIMIT 15
